notes_zh: 🐭 桌宠菜单方向感知：在屏幕角落（尤其右下/左下）点出菜单时，菜单会往屏幕内侧自动翻转展开（贴右→往左、贴左→往右），不再被屏幕边切掉一截；同时桌宠不再被菜单撑大窗口时拽回角落乱跳。安装包仍 12 MB。
notes_en: 🐭 Edge-aware pet menu: when the pet sits in a screen corner (esp. bottom-right/left), the menu now flips toward the screen interior (anchored right→opens left, left→opens right) instead of getting clipped, and the pet no longer jumps when the menu expands the overlay window. Still a 12 MB DMG.
